title: Security fix for GO-2026-5932 applied in: migrate 4.19.1-r6, gitea 1.27.3-r4
description: The security issue identified as GO-2026-5932 affects multiple packages including migrate and gitea. The vulnerability is resolved in migrate version 4.19.1-r6 and gitea version 1.27.3-r4. No specific technical details or impact descriptions are provided in the available data.
